This monoclinic structure, with composition Mg2Fe4O8 (reduced formula MgFe2O4), crystallizes in space group C2/c (No. 194) and contains 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mg adopts a four-coordinate O environment and O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by two Fe and two Mg neighbors. The connectivity forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between Fe octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Fe octahedra and Mg four-vertex polyhedra.
